metadata.description: A collection of public open-source tools for builders, by Brian Casel @ Builder Methods (buildermethods.com).

plugins.name: bm-prd-creator
plugins.description: Guides you through creating a Product Requirements Document (PRD) for a new app or feature.

plugins.name: bm-design-system
plugins.description: Guides you through creating a design system for a new app or feature.

plugins.name: bm-favicon-creator
plugins.description: Generate a complete favicon set from a Lucide icon (or another source SVG) and wire the meta tags into your codebase.
